text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
We're halfway through summer camp. I
upload
another four-panel comic, then
take a look at the
blog's analytics.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It looks like traffic peaked during the
Oka Sho.
The numbers have been
gradually falling since,
but they're still
higher than when we first
launched.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
My motivation reinvigorated, I head off
to our
training session in high spirits. On
my way,
though...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: How is it? Tasty?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I find Aston Machan being treated to a
meal by
Hishi Amazon, the kind and
caring Miho dorm
leader.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: Munch, munch... Mmm... I think I can manage this.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: Thank you, Hishiama.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Don't sweat it. More importantly, I want
you to
promise me you won't do this
again.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Even if you don't feel hungry, you can't
just skip
out on meals before training!

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
But I ran just fine yesterday, even on an
empty
stomach.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She hadn't eaten anything?! ...I feel
weak all of a
sudden.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: Oh. Hello, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: ...What's wrong? You look unwell.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I didn't even notice that Aston Machan
had lost
her appetite. If Hishi Amazon
hadn't said
anything, who knows what
could've happened.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
...Wait, hold on. So Machan didn't tell
you she
was feeling fatigued from the
heat?

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: You should've realized? ...I wonder.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: ...Hmm.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
At any rate, don't worry about the meal!
I just
threw it together anyway.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
More importantly...
Machan! Can you
come with me for a moment?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
...Listen. I know I'm being a bit of a pain
right
now, but you have to promise me
something else.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
When it comes to your health, and your
future
plans, too, for that matter...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Anything important like that—you need
to let
your trainer know about it.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: ...Oh? How come?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: Because your trainer's your partner.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: My partner...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
The whole reason your trainer's there is
to help
you deal with any problems you
might face during
the Twinkle Series.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Your trainer isn't someone you should
take for
granted.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: Yeah... I suppose you're right.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
...I am. And I know someday you'll
understand.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
(I understand what Hishiama was saying,
but...)

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
(...I really think my problems are mine
alone to
deal with.)

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Finished. Go, me! This is the best
painting I've
ever done!

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Hehe. I have to show this to someone
right awa...

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
I finally finished this scarf. This is the
first time
I've ever finished anything. And
it's all thanks to
you for showing me how
to do it.

text_block_list.name: Inpatient T
text_block_list.text:
...Oh, Machan. You've done a wonderful
job. But
I'm really sorry. I'm not feeling
very well today
and—

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: Yes, to... show it to...

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Huh? Mrs. T had to go to an even bigger

hospital?

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: ...I see. I didn't know she'd left.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Mrs. B left the hospital. Mr. C quit his
job. Mr. D
and Mrs. A went to the sea.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
So I won't be able to see any of them
anymore.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
...
...It's fine, really.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Everyone's river is unique. The length,
depth, and
how fast it flows is different
for all of us. We can't
stay next to each
other for long.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
It's only natural. So I suppose I should
just...

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Oh, look. What a beautiful picture I've
made!

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: Isn't that great?

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: ...Yes, I think it is.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Our boats only hold one person each.
We're
taken downstream, alone and in
private, as the
rapids toss each of us
about on our way to the
sea.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: So... so I'm sure...

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
My trainer must be in a separate boat
too.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Your trainer isn't someone you should
take for
granted.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: ...I wonder what she meant.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
What does it mean to take someone for
granted?

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Have I been treating my trainer... badly,

somehow?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The next day, although Aston Machan
has the
day off training, she shows up at
my office with a
very humble demeanor
about her.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Would you like to go somewhere today?
We
could go to the beach or the
mountains.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
There's something I need to know. So,
first of all,
which would you prefer?

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
If we go to the mountains, let's see... we
can look
for the strongest stag beetle.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
And if we go to the beach, well... we can
try to
find the toughest sea cucumber.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I'm not sure where this is coming from... but I am stuck for ideas for our next four-panel comic right now. So I suppose...

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
So you'd like to go the mountains, then.
Okay,
let's get going.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
I have a question for you, Miss
Squeezypinch.
Which beetle around
here is the mightiest?

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: ...Hm. I see.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: She says she doesn't know.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
We search for hours and hours, and day
turns to
night without us even realizing.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Ah, the beach. I know just the place.
Let's head
there now.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: Here's my status report, Survey Captain.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
I've found a jellyfish named Tingly and a
crab
called Pincer.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: As for sea cucumbers... nothing yet. Sigh...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
We search for hours and hours, and day
turns to
night without us even realizing.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
It's gotten quite late, hasn't it? The stars
have
come out, and they look extra
twinkly out here.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
On the way back, I make a note of
everything
Aston Machan said and did
today so I don't
forget any details.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: ...What are you doing? Is that a diary?

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
I see... So even on days off like today,
you have
the blog on your mind.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
I think I understand you a little bit more
now,
Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: You're very dedicated to your work.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Honestly, I probably wouldn't be
working on the
blog on my days off if I
considered it "work,"
but...

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Now I know. And today turned out to be
a nice
summer day. ...Hehe. Another step
forward.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
If that's what she believes, then I'll just
keep
quiet.
